Extremely unhelpful, inefficient and seem to revel in being able to refuse appointments. I've never met a more unhelpful set of receptionists. Made even more annoying by the things they refused to help with suddenly being able to be rectified as soon as a complaint was made and miraculously an appointment became available

Being told by a receptionist 'you could always go to a different GP surgery if you don't like being told we don't have any appointments' is beyond a joke. It seems like it would take a serious case review for the staff and receptionist to actually do anything that required the minimum amount of effort on their behalf

The above combined with the complete inability to stick to appointment times means you'll spend at least an hour waiting to be called for your actual time slot
